lede: Wat Muang Ton accounts for 2 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lamphun (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (50%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (50%). Dated witnesses run 1888–1913 CE (2 of 2 carry a date).
